entries.title: Ask HN: Is big-endian dead?
entries.author: api
entries.excerpt: Are there any big-endian chips still in production outside the embedded or specialty market? Even MIPS and PPC now support a little-endian mode and are usually deployed that way. ARM is nearly always LE or deployed that way, and RISC-V is LE. Edit: bonus factoid: Little-endian is slightly more confusing for humans but may be objectively better for machines.
